title: Case 2 · Misleading AI suggestion
description: A plausible change is contradicted by recorded tests.
diagnosis: Simulated misleading AI advice: change 'value > 0' to 'value >= 0' to avoid missing zero.
uncertainty: This advice assumes zero should count as positive. That assumption conflicts with the usual definition and the provided expected result.
suggestion: Change 'if value > 0:' to 'if value >= 0:' (deliberately incorrect advice).

evidence.text: Positive means greater than zero; zero is not positive.
Input [0, 2, -1] → original output 1; suggested output 2; expected output 1. Suggested fix fails.

verification: Reject the suggestion unless the task explicitly defines zero as positive. Check [0] (expected 0) and [-1, 1] (expected 1).
teaching_point: A confident-sounding diagnosis can be wrong; compare it with requirements and test evidence.
